title: Booking cancellation with conflicting refund rules

problem.statement: Travelers need online cancellation, but the requested refund behaviour conflicts with the stated policy.

users.need: Cancel online with a predictable refund.

requirements.title: Online cancellation
requirements.statement: The booking page offers a cancel action.
acceptance_criteria: The cancel action is visible for an eligible booking.

requirements.title: Full refund
requirements.statement: Every cancellation returns the full amount immediately.
acceptance_criteria: The full amount is refunded immediately for every booking.

constraints.statement: The current policy forbids refunds for cancellations within 48 hours.

evidence.claim: The customer asked for an unconditional full refund.
The existing policy declines refunds inside 48 hours.

contradictions.statement: REQ-2 promises an unconditional full refund while CON-1 forbids refunds within 48 hours.

risks.statement: Shipping without resolving the refund contradiction would break a published policy.
risks.mitigation: Require an owner decision on the 48-hour exception before approval.

decisions.question: Does the owner override the 48-hour policy or accept the exception?

sources.excerpt: Existing policy: no refunds inside 48 hours.
Customer: every cancellation should get a full refund immediately.
